title: Think Once, Act Fast: Cost-Effective Recursive Self-Improvement for Decision Model Harness
abstract: arXiv:2611.22432v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Fast System-1 models enable responsive actions but struggle with complex or unfamiliar tasks. Large language model (LLM)-based System-2 provides strong reasoning capabilities, yet repeated invocation incurs substantial latency and computational costs. To bridge this gap, we propose JevRSI, a System-1/System-2 collaboration framework that transforms LLM reasoning into transferable decision support through recursive harness improvement. A Jev-style System-1 model enables low-latency action selection, while an asynchronous System-2 LLM develops a modular harness. The harness integrates procedures, state memory, and world models to provide decision contexts spanning the past, present, and future. Utility-driven retrieval selects modules based on both contextual relevance and their utility on previous tasks. tldr: 提出JevRSI系统1/系统2协作框架，通过递归式模块化框架改进将LLM推理转化为可迁移、高性价比的决策支持，兼顾低延迟动作选择与持续自我改进能力。
